title: The boat finds the channel
base_prompt:
Fully animated cinematic stylized-realistic 3D CGI feature-film shot, continuous motion, expressive character animation and acting, believable fur and cloth simulation, detailed wet stone and metal, dynamic ocean, rain, spray, steam and sparks, cinematic lighting, anamorphic 16:9 widescreen, 24 fps.
Setting: open sea beyond the reef, the distant lighthouse on its cliff on the horizon. Time and weather: clear golden morning, warm amber sunlight, calm sparkling ocean, gentle breeze.
Characters (keep exactly on-model): a small battered red-and-white fishing boat with a lit wheelhouse, tossing on the waves.
Camera: aerial shot following the boat through the channel; one continuous shot, no cuts.
Action: Guided by the lighthouse beam, the little fishing boat steers safely through the channel between the rocks into calm water as the morning brightens; the radio crackles.
Dialogue: The fishing boat (crackly, weather-beaten middle-aged fisherman's voice heard over radio static, crackly over radio static) says: "Lighthouse, we can see the channel. Thank you!"
Sound: engine putter, gentle waves, radio crackle.
Audio: realistic sound effects and ambience only; spoken dialogue only as written above; no background music; no narrator.
